sloka: मया वर्षसहस्राणि चरित्वा दुश्चरं तपः।तेषु तेष्ववकाशेषु स्वयम्भूः परितोषितः ।। ६.९३.२८ ।।
transliteration: mayā varṣasahasrāṇi caritvā duścaraṁ tapaḥ।teṣu teṣvavakāśeṣu svayambhūḥ paritoṣitaḥ ।। 6.93.28 ।।

translations.english: 'I have done penance for thousands of years several times and am a pleased selfborn creator'.
